I'm sorry the fern isn't working in your space. The policy information I have doesn't cover returns for a change of mind, so I can't confirm whether you can send it back or get a refund. I can escalate this to a Support Lead who can give you a definite answer.

If the fern arrived damaged (snapped main stem, cracked pot, exposed roots, or dead or severely wilted), report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. We'd then offer a free replacement or a refund.

Would you like me to escalate this? If so, please send your order number (it looks like LF-123456).
